You start at  (7, 9). You move up 1 unit. Where do you end?


(, )

content.html:
An ordered pair (x, y) describes the location of a point on the coordinate plane.
  • The first coordinate, x, tells you the position of the point along the x-axis.
  • The second coordinate, y, tells you the position of the point along the y-axis.

First find the starting point, (7, 9).


Now follow the path. You move up 1 unit to (7, 10).


You end at (7, 10).
